div.p: What is this screen? A question box for getting a quick answer from the customer's Odoo data.

ul.li: Ask why health is low, what changed, or what needs attention.
Find recent support, communication, renewal, and activity context.
Prepare before opening several records manually.

div.p: Start here: Ask one clear question. Use the answer to find the right records, then verify dates, amounts, commitments, and risks before deciding. The answer does not change customer data.

form.div: 🤖 — اسأل أي سؤال عن هذا العميل (الوضع، الصحة، المخاطر، التجديد، آخر التفاعلات…)

field.name: question
field.placeholder: مثال: ليش صحة هذا العميل منخفضة؟ متى آخر تواصل؟ هل فيه فرص بيع؟

button.name: action_ask
button.help: Ask a focused question about this customer. The answer is grounded in the Customer Success record and timeline; verify important facts in their source records before acting.
Close the copilot. The generated answer is advisory and is not written back to customer fields or sent externally.
